purpose: Pre-specified support and exclusion panels for conservative AF/NP resident-cell annotation
score_definition: For each cell and panel, mean log1p(CPM) over measured genes in the fixed panel; CPM uses that cell's total UMI. Detection counts are reported separately.

rules.note: Thresholds are fixed before expression results. Anatomical source from GEO remains primary; marker disagreement is reported but does not overwrite source. AF and NP support coexpression is not a doublet criterion because both are disc matrix programs. A doublet_or_mixed label requires source-matched resident support together with a nonresident exclusion panel.
